id.description: The version's own id (a Sqid): a learner's choice of voice names it.

url.description: The AAC (MP4 with its edit list) on the CDN, at an immutable address.

sampleRate.description: The rate the file was made at; scale frame counts to the AudioContext's rate.

frames.description: The exact length, at sampleRate, for the AAC priming check.

offsetFrames.description: Where the file starts, in frames at sampleRate after the template's beat 0.

credit.description: "Sarah K.", or null when the singer chose to stay anonymous.

creditHandle.description: The credited singer's profile handle, to link the credit to; null unless they're credited by name and have a public profile.

source.description: recorded: a real singer's take. ai: an AI voice standing in until a real singer records the part (docs/ai-voices-plan.md); always labelled as AI, never credited as a singer.

aiBasedOn.description: Only for an AI voice: the name for "AI voice based on <name>'s singing, with permission", when its singer chose to be credited; null for an AI voice not based on a named person or whose singer chose no credit (the plain AI label), and always null for a recorded one.

mine.description: Only in beta.parts.list: true when this is the signed-in singer's own take.

default.description: Only in the catalogue's versions: this is the part's default voice.
